cells.gaps: The GPU server's named users are public bodies and the Togo AI Lab that runs it; no source found says it is open to outside researchers, startups or other countries.
cells.note: UNDP says the GPU server at Lomé Data Centre, run by Togo AI Lab, has been in service since July 2026 and handled about 50,200 requests by 27 October 2026 (TGO-014). Its users named are government departments and the lab itself, reached over an internal network, so not 5.
